lines.zh: : 你意识到我未成年吧？我不能喝酒。

lines.en: : Since when do you give a shit about the law? You steal TVs and had no problem buying me cigarettes the other day.
lines.zh: : 你什么时候在乎过法律？你偷电视，前天买烟给我眼睛都不眨一下。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. Beer just kinda tastes like shit. I’ll grab a water, though.
lines.zh: : 行吧。主要是啤酒实在难喝。不过我拿瓶水。

lines.en: : Oh, and if he comes back in here with you, I’m out. Ain’t got time to watch you two be all buddy-buddy and shit all night.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，要是他跟你一起回来，我就走。我可没时间看你们俩一晚上哥俩好似的腻歪。

lines.en: : Got it.
lines.zh: : 知道了。

lines.en: scene black
: Come on, McDouchefuck. Me and you are gonna have a little chat.
lines.zh: : 过来，麦克混蛋。我和你要谈两句。

lines.en: scene yumiapt24
: It’s “You and I.”
lines.zh: : 是「你和我」。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : You said “me and you are going to have a little chat” when it should be “You and I are going to have a little chat.”
lines.zh: : 你说的是「我和你要谈两句」，应该是「你和我」。

lines.en: : Do you want to keep your balls?
lines.zh: : 你想保住你的蛋吗？

lines.en: : I would prefer them to remain attached to my body, yes.
lines.zh: : 我更希望它们继续长在我身上，是的。

lines.en: : Cool. Then don’t correct me like that. I know I’m a fucking idiot, but it’s annoying when people just remind me.
lines.zh: : 很好。那就别那样纠正我。我知道我是个操蛋的白痴，但别人提醒我的时候很烦。

lines.en: : Gotcha...So, about what happened in there...
lines.zh: : 明白了……那么，关于刚才在里面发生的事……

lines.en: : What about it?
lines.zh: : 关于什么？

lines.en: : Isn’t that...what you wanted to talk about?
lines.zh: : 那不就是……你想谈的事吗？

lines.en: scene yumiapt25
: You mean about the thing with you wanting to hook up with me? Nah. That ain’t got shit to do with this.
lines.zh: : 你是说你想跟我搞在一起那件事？不。那跟这个一点关系都没有。

lines.en: : Surprised the fuck out of me, though. Figured you were just messing around this whole time.
lines.zh: : 不过确实把我他妈吓到了。我原以为你从头到尾都在逗我玩。

lines.en: : I also think it’s a shit idea for the two of us to go down that path since I’ll only wind up draggin’ you into my never-ending sob story, but that ain’t what I wanted to talk about.
lines.zh: : 我也觉得我们俩走那条路是个操蛋的主意，因为我最后只会把你拖进我那个没完没了的惨事里，不过那不是我想谈的。

lines.en: : Then what-
lines.zh: : 那是什么——

lines.en: : I want to know what the fuck happened with Yumi and that Nodoka girl. She won’t tell me shit.
lines.zh: : 我想知道 Yumi 和那个 Nodoka 之间他妈到底发生了什么。她一个字都不肯说。

lines.en: : I was fine with that at first, but the more I think about it, the more fucked up I’m getting.
lines.zh: : 一开始我也无所谓，但我想得越多，就越觉得不对劲。

lines.en: : I didn’t teach her much, we all know that, but I know damn well she wouldn’t fuck someone up {i}that{/i} bad unless she had a reason to.
lines.zh: : 我没教过她多少东西，这我们都知道，但我他妈清楚得很——除非有理由，她不会把人揍成{i}那样{/i}。

lines.en: : And what makes you think I know that reason?
lines.zh: : 那你凭什么认为我知道那个理由？

lines.en: : She told me.
lines.zh: : 她告诉我的。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well yeah, that’s pretty damning.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那确实很要命。

lines.en: scene yumiapt26
: The fuck you have to gain from hiding it? Ain’t like I’m gonna do anything. I just want to know what the fuck is going on.
lines.zh: : 你藏着不说能捞到什么好处？我又不会做什么。我只是想知道他妈到底怎么回事。

lines.en: scene yumiapt27
: This isn’t really something I should let myself get dragged any further into. If Yumi can tell you that I know what’s going on, she can definitely tell you what happened herself.
lines.zh: : 这事我真不该再被拖得更深。如果 Yumi 能告诉你我知道怎么回事，那她当然也能自己告诉你发生了什么。

lines.en: scene yumiapt28
: Just because she’s sleeping on my couch and eating my TV dinners doesn’t mean she’s gonna just spill her heart out to me.
lines.zh: : 她睡在我沙发上、吃着我的电视晚餐，不代表她就会对我掏心掏肺。

lines.en: : Doubt we’ll ever get to that level after the shit we’ve been through. But I’m still gonna worry about her.
lines.zh: : 我看我们经历了这些破事之后，大概永远到不了那个程度。可我还是会担心她。

lines.en: : And...I don’t want to say I {i}deserve{/i} to know what’s going on in her life, but...
lines.zh: : 而且……我不想说我{i}有权{/i}知道她生活里发生了什么，不过……

lines.en: scene yumiapt29
: Uhh...hello? The hell are you doing here? You can’t just come all the way to my apartment complex and then only hang out with my neighbors.
lines.zh: : 呃……你好？你他妈在这儿干嘛？你不能大老远跑到我的公寓楼，却只跟我的邻居混。

lines.en: : I’ll admit that I’ve heard your voice in my head on several occasions, but I seriously thought I was going insane tonight with how much of it I heard. You’ve got some explaining to do.
lines.zh: : 我承认我脑子里听到过你好几次声音，但今晚听到的量，让我真以为自己要疯了。你得给我解释一下。

lines.en: : Friend of yours?
lines.zh: : 你朋友？

lines.en: : Subordinate.
lines.zh: : 下属。

lines.en: scene yumiapt30
: {i}Subordinate?!{/i}
: Is that all I am to you? Because I’m all about power dynamics, Senpai, but not like this!
lines.zh: : 我在你眼里就只是这样吗？因为我可是很吃权力关系这一套的，Senpai，但不是这种！

lines.en: : Surprise. I’m here because I missed you.
lines.zh: : 惊喜吧。我来是因为想你了。

lines.en: : I was just the appetizer. He’s all yours now...whatever your name is.
lines.zh: : 我只是开胃菜。他现在全归你了……不管你叫什么名字。

lines.en: scene yumiapt31
: Imani Imai. Nice to finally meet you, intimidating onee-san in the room next to mine.
lines.zh: : Imani Imai。很高兴终于见到你了，住我隔壁的、让人有压迫感的 onee-san。

lines.en: : Yuki Yamaguchi. Think I gave you a beer during that weird ass contest thing you guys had at Sakaki-bar-a. Nice to actually meet you for real this time.
lines.zh: : Yuki Yamaguchi。我记得在你们在 Sakaki-bar-a 办的那场怪得要死的比赛上给过你一瓶啤酒。这次算是真正认识了。

lines.en: : You know, I {i}knew{/i} I recognized you from somewhere and-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我{i}就觉得{/i}在哪儿见过你，而且——

lines.en: : Sorry, did you say “Yamaguchi?”
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你刚说「Yamaguchi」？

lines.en: : Yup.
: Welp, that certainly explains the other familiar auditory hallucination I just had as well. Glad that mystery is over and done with.
lines.zh: : 呃，那大概也解释了我刚才另一个熟悉的幻听。很高兴这个谜团到此为止。

lines.en: : Are you going somewhere?
lines.zh: : 你要去哪儿？

lines.en: : My boyfriend’s house.
lines.zh: : 我男朋友家。

lines.en: : Cool. Have fun.
lines.zh: : 酷。玩得开心。

lines.en: scene yumiapt32
: He doesn’t mean that. We’re closer than this. Oh, Senpai. You’re so funny.
lines.zh: : 他不是那个意思。我们比这更亲近。哦，Senpai。你真有意思。

lines.en: : She’s probably just going to the bar to meet up with some of our other friends. We do that sometimes.
lines.zh: : 她大概只是去酒吧见我们其他几个朋友。我们有时会这样。

lines.en: : Really? Only saw her there the one time, I think. Maybe two, but that’s pushing it.
lines.zh: : 真的？我印象里只在那儿见过她一次。也许两次，但那是往多了说。

lines.en: : Not your bar. Another bar.
lines.zh: : 不是你家那家酒吧。另一家。

lines.en: scene yumiapt33
: {i}Another{/i} bar?! You’re cheating on us?
lines.zh: : {i}另一家{/i}酒吧？！你在背着我们一起鬼混？

lines.en: : I can explain.
lines.zh: : 我可以解释。

lines.en: : Sara’s heart’s gonna fuckin’ shatter.
lines.zh: : Sara 的心要他妈碎了。

lines.en: : Then don’t tell her.
lines.zh: : 那就别告诉她。

lines.en: : Senpai, just out of curiosity, is there any woman in Kumon-mi that you are not having sex with?
lines.zh: : Senpai，出于好奇问一句，Kumon-mi 里还有哪个女人是你没上过的吗？

lines.en: scene yumiapt34
: Yes, but {i}not for long.{/i}
lines.zh: : 有，不过{i}维持不了多久{/i}。

lines.en: : I really worry about you sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我有时候真的很担心你。

lines.en: : Uhh...anyway, sorry Imani, but this guy and I were in the middle of a pretty private conversation and...you’re gonna have to get the fuck out of here.
lines.zh: : 呃……总之，抱歉啊 Imani，不过这家伙和我正在谈一件相当私密的事，而你……得他妈离开这儿。

lines.en: scene yumiapt35
: Understood! I’ll go be jealous somewhere else! But, should you ever find yourself without anything to do, you should join us at that dive around the corner! That’s our spot now.
lines.zh: : 明白！我去别处吃醋！不过，哪天你要是闲着没事，可以来拐角那家小馆子找我们！那是我们的据点了。

lines.en: : How cool is that? We have a spot. We’re a group of friends with a spot. I’m finally popular after all these years!
lines.zh: : 酷不酷？我们有据点了。我们是一群有据点的朋友。这么多年过去，我终于合群了！

lines.en: : It’s time to leave, Imani.
lines.zh: : 该走了，Imani。

lines.en: scene yumiapt36
: You’re going to appreciate me one day. Mark my words, Senpai.
lines.zh: : 总有一天你会珍惜我的。记住我的话，Senpai。

lines.en: : I would appreciate you more off-screen.
lines.zh: : 你要是不在画面里，我会更珍惜你。

lines.en: scene yumiapt37
: God, is this really what Makoto’s been dealing with all year long?! Why are you so mean to the people who help you the most?!
lines.zh: : 天啊，Makoto 这一整年他妈受的就是这种罪吗？！你为什么对帮你最多的人这么刻薄？！

lines.en: : Are you two-
lines.zh: : 你们俩——

lines.en: : No. Not yet at least. We’re just friends.
lines.zh: : 没有。至少现在还没有。我们只是朋友。

lines.en: : Gotcha...
lines.zh: : 明白了……

lines.en: scene yumiapt38
: Anyway, about the Yumi thing-
lines.zh: : 总之，关于 Yumi 那件事——

lines.en: : Let’s...take a rain check on the Yumi thing. I’ll see if I can get any more out of her since I know you ain’t gonna tell me shit.
lines.zh: : Yumi 那件事……我们改天再说。既然我知道你一个字都不会告诉我，我就自己看能不能从她那儿多问出点什么。

lines.en: : Go join your friend at the bar. Seemed nice. And a lot closer to your age than a certain someone you almost made the mistake of kissing tonight.
lines.zh: : 去酒吧找你朋友吧。看着挺不错。而且比起某个你今晚差点犯下错误去亲的人，她离你的年纪近多了。

lines.en: : It wouldn’t have been a mistake.
lines.zh: : 那不会是个错误。

lines.en: : It would have. But it’s cool. Sometimes people get caught up in the moment or whatever. Ain’t gonna hold it against you.
lines.zh: : 会的。不过没关系。有时候人会被气氛冲昏头什么的。我不会拿这个怪你。

lines.en: : But, before you go telling me I’m wrong again, do me a favor and get the fuck out of here. Yumi’s gonna bail if I stay outside any longer and the cheapest pizza place around is gonna be closing soon.
lines.zh: : 不过，在你又要说我说错之前，帮我个忙，赶紧他妈滚蛋。我再在外面待下去 Yumi 就要跑了，而且附近最便宜的那家披萨店快打烊了。

lines.en: : You sure you don’t want to come to the bar as well? One of the girls is both older {i}and{/i} more heavily tattooed than you.
lines.zh: : 你确定不也来酒吧吗？其中一个女孩年纪比你大，纹身{i}也{/i}比你多。

lines.en: : Oooh, tempting. She have an unruly daughter as well?
lines.zh: : 哦哦，真诱人。她也有个不听话的女儿吗？

lines.en: : If by “unruly” you mean “impulsive and horny” then yes.
lines.zh: : 如果「不听话」是指「冲动又饥渴」的话，有。

lines.en: : Maybe some other time. Secretly, of course.
lines.zh: : 也许改天吧。当然是偷偷地。

lines.en: scene yumiapt39
: Got somethin’ else I should be doin’ right now. Would be an idiot to walk away from that again, even if it is temporary.
lines.zh: : 我现在还有别的事该做。哪怕只是暂时的，再从那件事旁边走开就是傻子。

lines.en: : I’m proud of you, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 我为你骄傲，Yuki。

lines.en: : You’re doing well.
lines.zh: : 你做得很好。

lines.en: scene yumiapt40
: Save it for the next girl you try to seduce, won’t ya? Got at least one both older {i}and{/i} more heavily tattooed than me waiting for you right now.
lines.zh: : 留给你下一个想勾引的女孩吧，好吗？现在至少有一个年纪比我大、纹身{i}也{/i}比我多的在等你。

lines.en: : Yeah...but she’s kind of...
lines.zh: : 是啊……不过她有点……

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I’ll just...wait until you meet her.
lines.zh: : 我就……等你见到她再说吧。

lines.en: scene nightsky
Yuki heads back into her apartment as I make my way down the stairs.
lines.zh: Yuki 转身回屋，而我走下楼梯。

lines.en: Seeing as I am now abandoning my original plans and heading to the dive bar instead, I send Imani a text and manage to catch up with her just before she heads inside.
lines.zh: 既然我放弃了原定计划、改去那家小馆子，我给 Imani 发了条短信，赶在她进门之前追上了她。

lines.en: scene black
I hope that everything went well with the Yamaguchis, but I guess I probably won’t know that until the next time I’m able to see Yuki.
lines.zh: 我希望和 Yamaguchi 母女有关的一切都顺利，不过大概要等到下次见到 Yuki 我才会知道。

lines.en: It’s strange, though. I remember Yumi saying something about how she spoke to her mom, but...I don’t think it was at {i}this{/i} level prior to the last reset.
lines.zh: 不过很奇怪。我记得 Yumi 说过她跟她妈聊过什么，但……我不记得在上一次重置之前已经到了{i}这个{/i}程度。

lines.en: This has to be some sort of aftereffect from that, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: 这肯定是那件事的某种后遗症，不是吗？

lines.en: I guess I’ll just have to...keep an eye out.
lines.zh: 我想我只能……留心观察了。

lines.en: Because as nice as it is that the two of them were able to grow a little closer without me around-
lines.zh: 因为尽管她们俩能在我不在场的情况下走近一点，这很好——

lines.en: I am frightened by the idea of anyone progressing without me.
lines.zh: 但任何人撇开我独自前进，这个想法让我恐惧。

lines.en: I want to be there for the ups and down.
lines.zh: 我想陪她们经历起起落落。

lines.en: I want to watch the world move.
lines.zh: 我想看着这个世界运转。
